description.p: Radanor Sparrow Community Edition is a lightweight, local cybersecurity application for one computer. It monitors file activity, assesses the security posture of the local machine with evidence-backed checks, shows the installed software and the listening network endpoints and services, and lets the user configure the scanner.
Everything runs in two unprivileged local processes and nothing leaves the computer. There is no account, no cloud service and no telemetry, and the application never asks for administrator rights.

ul.li: Security posture checks with the evidence that produced each result
File activity monitoring with configurable local sources
Installed software and listening endpoint inventory
Local history stored in a private SQLite database owned by the user
Native GTK/WebKitGTK window, or the authenticated dashboard in the default browser where the WebKit sandbox cannot run

description.p: Radanor Sparrow is not antivirus and not EDR: it does not detect malware, block anything, remove anything, or produce a protection score.
